question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **compelling** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Compelling **means evoking interest, attention, or admiration; convincing and persuasive. (रुचि, ध्यान या प्रशंसा जगाना; आश्वस्त करने वाला और प्रेरक) • **Example**: *The speaker delivered a compelling argument that convinced the audience.* • In the context of the given passage, "**compelling**" is used to stress the persuasive and significant nature of the stability implications related to the growth of digital lending in the financial sector. Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Optional: **Not mandatory; left to one's choice. (अनिवार्य नहीं; किसी की पसंद पर छोड़ दिया गया) • **Discretional: **Subject to one's discretion or judgment. (किसी के विवेक या निर्णय के अधीन) • **Insignificant: **Lacking importance or relevance; not significant. (महत्व या प्रासंगिकता का अभाव; महत्वपूर्ण नहीं है) 41:Tb08, The correct answer is: **ensuring**
